evals.prompt: 帮我搜一下 Geom-GCN 这篇论文，出自 ICLR 2020，作者是 Hongbin Pei
evals.expected_output: Search for the paper, resolve its identity, and generate metadata.yaml under $PAPERS_DIR with correct folder_slug.
expectations: The skill calls paper-search search with a relevant query containing 'Geom-GCN'
A metadata.yaml file is generated under $PAPERS_DIR/{folder_slug}
The folder_slug follows the {venue}{year}-{method}-{first_author} format, e.g. iclr2020-geom-gcn-pei
The metadata.yaml contains identity section with arxiv ID 2002.05287
The metadata.yaml contains bibliography section with authors, year, venue

evals.prompt: 帮我查一下 DOI 10.48550/arxiv.1706.03762 对应的论文
evals.expected_output: Resolve the DOI to a paper identity and generate metadata.yaml.
expectations: The skill searches using the DOI via crossref or semantic scholar sources
A metadata.yaml is generated with the DOI in identity.aliases
The identity section identifies this as the 'Attention Is All You Need' paper (arXiv 1706.03762)
The urls section includes a canonical URL for the paper

evals.expected_output: Resolve the arXiv ID directly and generate metadata.yaml.
expectations: The skill searches arxiv source with the ID 2002.05287
A metadata.yaml is generated with arxiv in identity.aliases
The urls.pdf field points to arxiv.org/pdf/2002.05287.pdf
The acquisition_hints section indicates LaTeX is available from arxiv

evals.prompt: 搜索最近关于 large language model reasoning 的论文，2024 年以后的
evals.expected_output: Search multiple sources with year filter and return top results.
expectations: The skill calls paper-search search with year filter -y 2024 or 2024-2026
Multiple sources are used (e.g. arxiv, semantic, openalex)
Results are returned with titles, authors, and years
The skill presents results to the user rather than auto-generating metadata for all of them

evals.prompt: 帮我搜一下 Sculpting Subspaces: Constrained Full Fine-Tuning in LLMs for Continual Learning 这篇论文
evals.expected_output: Find the paper, detect its ICLR 2026 venue via web-kit, and generate metadata.yaml with correct venue and publication status.
expectations: The skill uses web-kit (ask-search) to search for the paper title
The skill uses paper-search CLI with layered sources (arxiv,semantic,crossref then dblp,openalex)
The metadata.yaml contains venue: ICLR (not empty, not preprint)
The metadata.yaml contains year: 2026 (not 2025 from arXiv upload)
The metadata.yaml contains publication_status: accepted
The folder_slug starts with iclr2026 (not arxiv2025 or preprint2025)
The metadata.yaml contains an openreview URL
